$comment: Public styling hooks of contract v1 (ADR 0005, section 5). A theme's theme.css and slot CSS may select only these myc-* classes and core data-* attributes; every other one is internal and can change in any release. An entry is a description, or { describes, layouts, states }: layouts names the region and variants where it appears (omitted: every variant), states the classes and attributes it takes. Adding a hook stays in contract v1; removing or renaming one is contract 2. The hooks were renamed from bd-* to myc-* before the first theme package was published (ADR 0005, amendment of 2026-10-08).

data-theme.describes: <html>: id of the active mode (the micelio-theme value).
data-theme.values: the ids of the theme's modes

data-layout.describes: The root element of a layout region: the variant it renders.

data-mode.describes: A button of the mode switch: the mode it selects (.myc-seg).
data-mode.values: the ids of the theme's modes

data-level.describes: Password strength meter: how many bars are lit (.myc-meter).

data-section.describes: The root of a page section: the section it renders (.myc-section).

data-variant.describes: The root of a page section: the variant it renders, always read together with data-section (ADR 0005, section 11). rich-text has none.

classes.myc-app: The page shell: header, main and footer.
classes.myc-wide: Display text that takes the heading tracking and width.
classes.myc-eyebrow: Small uppercase label above a title.
classes.myc-sr: Visually hidden text for screen readers.
classes.myc-reveal: A block that fades in when scrolled into view.
classes.myc-post-media: Cover of a post (card, featured card, article): the element that takes part in the card to article view transition. The core sets its view-transition-name; do not set one.
classes.myc-post-title: Title of a post (card, featured card, article h1): the element that takes part in the card to article view transition. The core sets its view-transition-name; do not set one.

myc-nav.describes: Main row of the header: logo, navigation and actions in bar; logo above the navigation in centered.

myc-header-inner.describes: Width-limited content of a header row.

myc-brand.describes: Link around the ThemeMark in the header.

myc-strip.describes: Second row of the header: breadcrumbs or HUD, and actions.

myc-strip-actions.describes: Actions at the end of the strip.

myc-progress.describes: Reading progress bar of the header on articles.

myc-progress-bar.describes: Filled part of the progress bar.

myc-progress-track.describes: Lane a ThemeProgressMarker travels along (the slot renders it); moved by the --myc-read custom property of .myc-progress.

myc-hud.describes: Place line of the header strip; rendered only when the theme has theme.hud messages.

classes.myc-seg-group: Group of segmented buttons: the mode switch and the language switch.
classes.myc-iconbtn: Button or link that holds only an icon.

myc-chip.describes: Small pill: a filter, a tag link, a shortcut.

myc-foot-main.describes: Brand and links of the footer: columns in columns, one row in minimal.

myc-foot-brand-col.describes: Column with the mark, tagline and social links.

myc-foot-brand.describes: Link around the ThemeMark in the footer.

myc-foot-tagline.describes: Short description under the footer mark.

myc-foot-nav.describes: A column of links (columns) or the row of links (minimal).

myc-foot-link.describes: A link of a column (columns) or of the footer row (minimal).

myc-foot-accordions.describes: The columns as accordions on small screens.

myc-foot-row.describes: A link row inside an accordion.

myc-foot-credits.describes: Legal line at the bottom of the footer.

myc-foot-legal.describes: Copyright, privacy link and source link.

myc-foot-source.describes: Link to the source code of the site, required by the AGPL (section 13): restyle it, do not hide it.

classes.myc-home-section: A home page section (also used by the about page blocks).
classes.myc-home-heading: Eyebrow and title of a section.

myc-home-featured.describes: The featured article of the home.

myc-home-lede.describes: Introduction of the home: site name, description and a link to the about page.

myc-home-lede-title.describes: Site name, the h1 of the index home.

myc-hero-art.describes: Box that holds the ThemeHero slot.

myc-hero-place.describes: Place line of the hero; rendered only when the theme has theme.hud messages.

myc-latest-grid.describes: Grid of the latest articles on the home.

myc-guide-grid.describes: Grid of the topic cards on the home.

myc-guide-card.describes: A topic card of the home.

myc-blog-head.describes: Title and lead of the list page.

myc-blog-controls.describes: View and sort controls (the view switch only with the grid variant).

myc-post-rows.describes: The ordered list of article rows.

myc-post-row.describes: An article row: date, title, excerpt and meta.

myc-post-row-title.describes: Title (h3) of a row; it holds the link that covers the row.

myc-post-row-link.describes: Link of a row title; its ::after covers the whole row.

myc-post-row-excerpt.describes: Excerpt or search snippet of a row.

myc-post-row-meta.describes: Category, fediverse stats and read mark of a row.

classes.myc-card-meta: Date and reading time of a card.
classes.myc-card-arrow: Arrow that marks a link to more.
classes.myc-latest-empty: Empty state of an article list.

myc-article-body.describes: Table of contents, content and share column.

myc-article-toc.describes: Table of contents: a column (aside) or a collapsed details (centered).

myc-article-toc-summary.describes: Summary that opens the collapsed table of contents.

myc-article-after.describes: Tags, reading path and author after the content.

myc-article-share.describes: Share buttons: a column beside the text (aside) or a row after it (centered).

classes.myc-toc-title: Title of the table of contents.

myc-toc-link.describes: A link of the table of contents.

classes.myc-prose: Rich text of an article: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, blockquotes (element selectors are allowed inside).
classes.myc-code-head: Language and copy button of a code block.
classes.myc-playground: A runnable code block: the code, its expected output and the result of running it.
classes.myc-playground-output: Expected output of a runnable code block.
classes.myc-refs: List of references of an article.

myc-section.describes: Root of a page section (a <section>). Select it with data-section and data-variant: .myc-section[data-section="hero"][data-variant="split"].

classes.myc-section-head: Eyebrow, title and text of a section.
classes.myc-section-text: Introduction or body text of a section (Markdown, server-rendered).
classes.myc-section-media: Image, video or poster of a section: the hero image, the showcase media, a scene poster.
classes.myc-section-actions: Buttons and links of a section (hero, cta, media-showcase).
classes.myc-section-items: The list of items: features, stats, logos, testimonials, plans, questions, gallery images, posts.
classes.myc-section-item-title: Title of an item: feature title, plan heading.

myc-section-logo-track.describes: Lane that holds the logos of logo-cloud; the marquee variant animates it (only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

classes.myc-section-author: Name, role and avatar of a testimonial.

myc-section-plan.describes: A pricing plan, also a myc-section-item.

classes.myc-section-plan-price: Price and billing period of a plan.
classes.myc-section-plan-features: List of the features of a plan.
classes.myc-section-question: Question of an faq item (the <summary> of a native <details>).

myc-btn.describes: A button or a link styled as one.

classes.myc-news-row: Input and button row of the newsletter form.

myc-news-msg.describes: Status message of the newsletter form.

classes.myc-tabbar: Bottom tab bar on small screens.

myc-tab.describes: A tab of the tab bar.

classes.myc-sheet-link: A link of the menu sheet.
